title: Phytopathogenic bacteria utilize host glucose as a signal to stimulate virulence through LuxR homologues.
authors: Zhang, Siyuan; Kan, Jinhong; Liu, Xin; Wu, Yao; Zhang, Mingyang; Ou, Jinqing; Wang, Juan; An, Lin; Li, Defeng; Wang, Li; Wang, Xiu-Jie; Fang, Rongxiang; Jia, Yantao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物病原细菌通过LuxR同源物感知宿主葡萄糖信号调控毒力基因表达，涉及蛋白-小分子（葡萄糖）结合与结构预测，但核心是细菌-植物跨界信号传导，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，且无AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract: Chemical signal-mediated biological communication is common within bacteria and between bacteria and their hosts. Many plant-associated bacteria respond to unknown plant compounds to regulate bacterial gene expression. However, the nature of the plant compounds that mediate such interkingdom communication and the underlying mechanisms remain poorly characterized. Xanthomonas campestris pv. campestris (Xcc) causes black rot disease on brassica vegetables. Xcc contains an orphan LuxR regulator (XccR) which senses a plant signal that was validated to be glucose by HPLC-MS. The glucose concentration increases in apoplast fluid after Xcc infection, which is caused by the enhanced activity of plant sugar transporters translocating sugar and cell-wall invertases releasing glucose from sucrose. XccR recruits glucose, but not fructose, sucrose, glucose 6-phosphate, and UDP-glucose, to activate pip expression. Deletion of the bacterial glucose transporter gene sglT impaired pathogen virulence and pip expression. Structural prediction showed that the N-terminal domain of XccR forms an alternative pocket neighbouring the AHL-binding pocket for glucose docking. Substitution of three residues affecting structural stability abolished the ability of XccR to bind to the luxXc box in the pip promoter. Several other XccR homologues from plant-associated bacteria can also form stable complexes with glucose, indicating that glucose may function as a common signal molecule for pathogen-plant interactions. The conservation of a glucose/XccR/pip-like system in plant-associated bacteria suggests that some phytopathogens have evolved the ability to utilize host compounds as virulence signals, indicating that LuxRs mediate an interkingdom signalling circuit.
abstract_zh: 化学信号介导的生物通讯在细菌内部以及细菌与其宿主之间普遍存在。许多与植物相关的细菌响应未知的植物化合物以调节细菌基因表达。然而，介导这种跨界通讯的植物化合物的性质及其潜在机制仍鲜有表征。野油菜黄单胞菌野油菜致病变种（Xanthomonas campestris pv. campestris, Xcc）引起芸薹属蔬菜的黑腐病。Xcc含有一个孤儿LuxR调节因子（XccR），其感知一种植物信号，经HPLC-MS验证为葡萄糖。Xcc感染后，质外体液体中的葡萄糖浓度升高，这是由于植物糖转运蛋白活性增强（转运糖）和细胞壁转化酶活性增强（从蔗糖释放葡萄糖）所致。XccR招募葡萄糖（而非果糖、蔗糖、葡萄糖-6-磷酸和UDP-葡萄糖）以激活pip表达。细菌葡萄糖转运蛋白基因sglT的缺失削弱了病原体毒力和pip表达。结构预测显示，XccR的N端结构域形成一个与AHL结合口袋相邻的替代口袋，用于葡萄糖对接。三个影响结构稳定性的残基替换消除了XccR与pip启动子中luxXc盒结合的能力。来自植物相关细菌的其他几个XccR同源物也能与葡萄糖形成稳定复合物，表明葡萄糖可能作为病原体-植物相互作用的常见信号分子。葡萄糖/XccR/pip样系统在植物相关细菌中的保守性表明，一些植物病原体已进化出利用宿主化合物作为毒力信号的能力，指示LuxRs介导一个跨界信号回路。
